title: Expand Range input and handle customization
description: Give the Elementor Filter Controller Range control deeper input styling and richer handle visual options, including Elementor icon library and SVG-upload support.
objective: Make Range styling more controllable inside Elementor without replacing native range behavior or accepting unsafe raw SVG input.
inputs_required: Guilherme request for more number input controls
Guilherme request for more Range handle shape options
Guilherme request for SVG/custom shape or icon-library handle support
Local Elementor 4.0.8 evidence that Controls_Manager::ICONS supports Icon Library and Upload SVG
expected_outputs: Range number inputs have their own Style heading and more controls.
Horizontal number inputs can be placed above or below the sliders.
Number inputs expose width, gap, height, color, background, border, radius, and padding controls.
Range handles expose more shape presets, border color, and border width controls.
Range handles can use Elementor Icon Library or SVG upload as a visual overlay.
The native range input remains the interactive control for accessibility and browser behavior.
Editor Style cadence includes the new Range controls.
acceptance_criteria: Existing Range widgets keep working with the old native handle when icon handle is disabled.
The old Circle, Rounded, and Square shape values remain valid.
Activating icon handle renders a visual overlay for both min and max sliders.
The visual overlay follows slider movement in horizontal and vertical orientations.
SVG customization uses Elementor's Icons control instead of a raw SVG text field.
The new Style controls appear only when a Range filter exists.
verification: JS syntax checks pass for editor, frontend, and admin assets.
PHP lint passes for plugin PHP files.
git diff --check passes in plugin and root.

budgets.complexity_budget: complex but bounded to Range UI controls and render path
budgets.context_budget: StyleControls, FilterController render, frontend CSS/JS, editor cadence, plugin version
budgets.research_budget: local Elementor icon control and Icons_Manager source
budgets.validation_budget: syntax, lint, composer, static diff checks, and Guilherme visual QA

risks: Native range thumb styling remains browser-dependent.
The icon handle is a visual overlay; the native input still owns the interaction.
Uploaded SVG rendering depends on Elementor's SVG handling and site permissions.
Nuanced visual quality and Elementor editor interaction require Guilherme QA.
